scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's identity and confirm their account information to ensure you're speaking with the correct person.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Tailor your communication to the customer's specific needs and preferences to build rapport and trust.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Acknowledge the customer's frustration and show understanding of their situation to diffuse tension and build rapport.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Repeat back what you've understood from the customer's issue to ensure you're on the same page and to show you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask diagnostic questions to clarify the customer's problem and gather more information to provide a more effective solution.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Take responsibility for resolving the issue and avoid blaming other departments or the customer to show accountability and professionalism.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly confirm with the customer that the issue has been resolved to ensure they're satisfied and to prevent future escalations.
